I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2025-01-15 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 07:45, must finish by 20:45
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 09:00, must finish by 19:45

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run as follows on January 15, 2025: the washing machine will start at 18:00 and finish by 18:45, while the dishwasher will begin at 18:15 and complete its cycle by 19:00. This schedule keeps your energy costs low and stays well within your household peak load limit. Enjoy your freshly cleaned dishes and laundry!
